title: Xenia and Divisors
statementMd:
Xenia the mathematician has a sequence consisting of $*n*$ ($*n*$ is divisible by 3) positive integers, each of them is at most 7. She wants to split the sequence into groups of three so that for each group of three $*a*, *b*, *c*$ the following conditions held:

- $*a* < *b* < *c*$;
- $*a*$ divides $*b*$, $*b*$ divides $*c*$.

Naturally, Xenia wants each element of the sequence to belong to exactly one group of three. Thus, if the required partition exists, then it has ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4de0f387b35d0865b1f96d528b2f1b06fb6f1903.png) groups of three.

Help Xenia, find the required partition or else say that it doesn't exist.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 99999)$ — the number of elements in the sequence. The next line contains $*n*$ positive integers, each of them is at most 7.

It is guaranteed that $*n*$ is divisible by 3.

## Output

If the required partition exists, print ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4de0f387b35d0865b1f96d528b2f1b06fb6f1903.png) groups of three. Print each group as values of the elements it contains. You should print values in increasing order. Separate the groups and integers in groups by whitespaces. If there are multiple solutions, you can print any of them.

If there is no solution, print -1.
statementZhMd:
数学家 Xenia 有一个由 $*n*$ 个（$*n*$ 能被 3 整除）正整数组成的序列，其中每个数都不超过 7。她希望将这个序列划分成若干组三元组，使得对于每组三个数 $*a*, *b*, *c*$，都满足以下条件：

- $*a* < *b* < *c*$；
- $*a*$ 整除 $*b*$，$*b*$ 整除 $*c*$。

当然，Xenia 希望序列中的每个元素恰好属于一组三元组。因此，如果所需的划分存在，那么就有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4de0f387b35d0865b1f96d528b2f1b06fb6f1903.png) 组三元组。

请帮助 Xenia 找到所需的划分，否则说明不存在这样的划分。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 99999$）——序列中元素的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个正整数，其中每个数都不超过 7。

保证 $*n*$ 能被 3 整除。

## 输出格式

如果所需的划分存在，输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4de0f387b35d0865b1f96d528b2f1b06fb6f1903.png) 组三元组。每组三元组输出其包含的元素值。应按递增顺序输出每组三元组中的值。不同组三元组之间以及同一组三元组中的整数之间使用空格分隔。如果有多种解，输出任意一种即可。

如果不存在这样的划分，输出 -1。
